question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    -- Calculate age on 2026-09-25: exactly 25 years old means completed 25 years
    -- Someone born on B is 25 on 2026-09-25 when:
    -- 25th anniversary of birth (B + 25 years) <= 2026-09-25
    -- AND 26th anniversary of birth (B + 26 years) > 2026-09-25
    -- This is equivalent to birth_date between 2001-09-26 and 2001-09-25 (inclusive)
    -- Actually: born on 2001-09-25 turns 25 on 2026-09-25
    -- born on 2001-09-26 turns 25 on 2026-09-26 (so on 2026-09-25 they are still 24)
    -- So exactly 25 on 2026-09-25 means birth_date = '2001-09-25'
    c.birth_date = '2001-09-25';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    -- Age exactly 25 on 2026-09-24
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-24') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) = 25
    AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= '09-24'
    AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) >= '01-01'
    OR 
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-24') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) = 26
    AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '09-24';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?

FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
    AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09'
    AND substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = '26'
);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (o.date >= c.birth_date
  AND o.date < strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years'))
  AND NOT (o.date >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years')
    AND o.date < strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+27 years'))
  AND (strftime('%Y-%m-%d', o.date) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+25 years')
    AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', o.date) < strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years'));

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-12-01') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
  AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= strftime('%m-%d', '2026-12-01')
  AND (strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > strftime('%m-%d', '2026-12-01')
       OR (strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) = strftime('%m-%d', '2026-12-01')
           AND CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-12-01') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25));

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
      CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
      AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5) <= '09-25'
      OR
      CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 < 2026
      AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5) <= '09-25'
      OR
      CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 > 2026
      AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5) > '09-25'
  )
  AND (
      (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25) * 10000 +
      CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 +
      CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
  ) <= 20260925
  AND (
      (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 26) * 10000 +
      CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 +
      CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
  ) > 20260925;

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, for orders placed from 2026-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-07-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')
  AND o.date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND (c.birth_date IS NOT NULL)
  AND (CAST((STRFTIME('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - 
        CASE WHEN (STRFTIME('%m', c.birth_date) > '09' OR 
                  (STRFTIME('%m', c.birth_date) = '09' AND STRFTIME('%d', c.birth_date) > '25')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 25);

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-05-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND (
      CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) > CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      OR (
        CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) = CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        AND CAST(strftime('%d', o.date) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      )
    )
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of product d only, for orders placed from 2026-09-01 00:00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.product_id = 'd'
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-25') >= 
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+' || (strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) || ' years')
    AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-25') < 
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+' || (strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) + 1) || ' years')
  );
